# Country flags

4:3 SVGs from flag-icons v7.5.0, MIT licence (included in LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons/tree/v7.5.0/flags/4x3

Vendored locally, with no third-party runtime requests. Only countries present
in the public station register are displayed. New entries use country_iso2
(lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. it, es, us). Flags indicate the geographic
representation of the register and do not infer institution affiliations.
